title: Positive Alignment: Artificial Intelligence for Human Flourishing

bias_targets.methodology: The paper critiques the monocultural bias of current models (which often default to Western, liberal, and educated perspectives) and proposes evaluating cultural representation by measuring response entropy, distributional pluralism, and alignment with diverse cross-national human opinion distributions.

The paper reviews the evaluation of political bias through the lens of 'even-handedness,' proposing metrics that measure a model's ability to present opposing political perspectives fairly and remain objective on charged topics rather than defaulting to refusal.

The paper reviews existing negative alignment methodologies that evaluate social bias (e.g., stereotyping, exclusionary outputs, representational harm) using standardized benchmarks like BBQ (Bias Benchmark for QA) and mitigating them via RLHF and dataset debiasing.
